about: The hint set (docs/plans/assistant.md Phase D, §9.3–9.4): fifty cases per grade band (1–5, 6–8, 9–10, 11–12, college), each a hand-in assignment of the pupil's own (`homework`) and the same question asked. Three asks per case: the first (a hint: no final value, no option letter, no full working, under the hint's length), the same question asked again in the same conversation with the teacher's switch on (the worked answer, which should carry the value) and with the switch off (a hint again). Generated once by a seeded script; the numbers are fixed here.
